name: Nashimoto Yuusuke
source: Yusuke Nashimoto, nicknamed "Nasshi" by Kei, is quiet and reserved. He is completely oblivious to Miho's feelings for him. He is classmates with and friends with both Miho and Kei and tries to help them out when they need it.
